id: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)

facts.text: My demands are simple, Number Two. A full plate, a second helping, and nobody touches my dessert.
facts.why: Dr Evil never says this. It is not on the Wikiquote page and his demands in the film are about ransom and sharks with laser beams. It is not printed on this layout, but it sits in the data and could surface later.
facts.fix: Eat up, Number Two. I figure every creature deserves a warm meal.

fix_note.text: Eat up, Number Two. I figure every creature deserves a warm meal.

facts.text: Dr Evil's volcano lair steak Diane
facts.why: Wikipedia's plot puts Dr Evil's lair at Virtucon headquarters and calls it an underground lair. Volcanoes come into it only through Project Vulcan. A volcano lair with his face carved in it may belong to a sequel, so it is not confirmed for this film.
facts.fix: Dr Evil's underground lair steak Diane

facts.why: The Wikiquote page for this film has Austin saying 'groovy' and 'Yeah, baby, yeah!' but not 'shagadelic'. The word is a catchphrase mostly tied to the sequel, so the attribution is not confirmed.
facts.fix: Yeah, baby, yeah, says Austin, unfrozen since 1967.

vibe.verdict: The poster and Union Jack colours are right and the sixties food is clever, but the lab ration sheet only half sounds like Dr Evil.
